dispute_ticket.description: I was only a couple of minutes late coming down from my office. The driver cancelled and I was charged $8.00 as a no-show. That is not fair, I was literally at the lift lobby. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: I'm at Tampines Mall main entrance, grey Prius.
coming down from the office, 3 more mins
almost at the lift lobby, sorry
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $8.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7101 booked trip RYDE-PT-001 from Tampines Mall to Changi Business Park. Pickup 08:30.
Driver pressed I'm Here; GPS 20 m from pickup pin.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event recorded.
$8.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive: a wait of exactly this many minutes already meets it.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrival_time is 08:30:00 and cancellation_time is 08:38:00, a wait of exactly 8 minutes. This trip's no_show_threshold_min is 8 and the policy text says the limit is inclusive, so the rider counts as a no-show. GPS shows the driver stationary at the pin from 08:30 to 08:38 and the rider's own chat (08:34 'coming down... 3 more mins', 08:36 'almost at the lift lobby') confirms she had not boarded. S$8.00 fee stands.
